notes.quota: B3/R2: an ENFORCED aggregate allowance for all model requests of one run (main, every retry, auxiliary and reviewer calls), paced by the Hermes runtime (patch 0007) from these values. max_output_tokens is the largest output any request may carry: Hermes raises the cap on a truncation retry to 32768 (conversation_loop.py:3956 at v2026.8.19). Admission (run-preflight.sh MODEL_RATE_BUDGET): max_requests_per_window x (max_input_tokens + max_output_tokens) + reserve_tokens_per_window <= the MaaSSubscription limit: 200 x 252768 + 9000000 = 59553600 <= 60000000 for qwen3-8-27b-int4.
notes.request_body: qwen3-8-27b-int4: the Qwen3.8-27B card's Instruct (non-thinking) row, https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B#api-usage . vLLM serves the THINKING row by default; workers run thinking off (v7 item 7, 2026-09-10). v12 (2026-09-24, t_655b1607) ran two responses to the full output cap without the row.
notes.source: B4: the ONE declared runtime profile per model and mode. dest-init generates every model-dependent worker setting from it (provider, caps, request body on the main slot and on every auto auxiliary slot, the request pacer); the migration-run provisioner pins a copy per run (<run>-run-control profile.json), and the loop refuses a runtime that differs from the pin.
notes.timeouts: vLLM buffers a tool call's arguments until complete; a ~12 KB file written through a tool call sends no bytes for ~4K tokens at ~18 tok/s, beyond Hermes's 120s default stream read timeout (pilot v5 M3 t_3efca989).
